title: Grilled Peruvian Chicken
description: A classic Peruvian dish featuring marinated chicken grilled to perfection, served with a side of warmly spiced slaw.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together mayo, lime juice, garlic powder, cumin, smoked paprika, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Let the chicken marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Grill the chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the warmly spiced slaw by combining mayonnaise, lime juice, garlic powder, cumin, smoked paprika, and a pinch of salt and pepper in a bowl.
Add the slaw to the grilled chicken and serve immediately.
Serve with a side of warmly spiced slaw.
